_comment: token: a CLASSIC PAT with repo + read:org - fine-grained tokens reach only one org each, and this board spans several. The API is called directly, so the gh CLI is not needed. Keep this file chmod 600.
_token_comment: Classic GitHub token; leave empty to read the named environment variable.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable that holds the GitHub token.
_accounts_comment: GitHub users or organizations to include; empty discovers the viewer and their organizations.
_window_days_comment: Days included in delivery charts and summaries.
